free_tier_limits: 100 API hits per day (Lifetime Free plan)
resolution_notes: pricing.free_tier_limits: auditor correct. Official CricketData pricing (https://cricketdata.org/pricing.aspx) publishes Lifetime Free at 100 API hits/day; sample API responses also expose info.hitsLimit:100 (e.g. docs/examples at https://cricketdata.org/ and https://api.cricapi.com/v1). Original "unknown" is wrong.
